packages.title: The listening circle reads as a picture, not the record button
packages.brief:
WEB-1611 (S2, regression R1H-1 of WP63, from verify-b1-r1-H.md). What the last attempt did: WP63 added, while listening, `span.voice-level[aria-hidden="true"]` (`src/components/VoiceDemo.tsx:965-973`) holding `<Icon name="mic" size={32} />`, styled at `src/styles/voice.css:307-320` with `color: var(--paper); background: var(--green);` and the mint halo `box-shadow: 0 0 0 calc(9px + var(--level, 0) * 21px) var(--mint)`. Why it fails: that is the idle ‘Tap to talk’ button (`.voice-record-button`, `voice.css:271-283`: an 80 px filled `var(--green)` disc, a white microphone, a 9 px mint halo) pixel for pixel, in the same place, so a visitor who tapped the microphone to start taps it again to stop, and nothing happens; Done sits about 90 px lower. Renders: `voice-recording.en.mobile.light.view.png`, `voice-recording-50s.en.desktop.dark.panel.png`. The app draws this as a mic that isn't a button: an outline microphone in the primary colour inside a thin level ring on the surface (`../TaskFlow/App/lib/screens/voice_task_screen.dart:2745-2776`). Do this, in `src/styles/voice.css` only, inside the `.voice-level` rule (`:307-320`; search for `.voice-level {` if lines moved): (1) replace `color: var(--paper);` with `color: var(--green);` (the microphone's stroke; `Icon` already draws with `stroke="currentColor"`, so it is an outline microphone with no icon change); (2) replace `background: var(--green);` with `background: transparent;` so the panel's `var(--surface)` shows through; (3) add `border: 2px solid var(--green);` (the thin ring; `box-sizing: border-box` is global, so the circle stays 80 × 80). Keep `display`, `place-items`, `width`, `height`, `margin`, `border-radius`, the `box-shadow` halo exactly as it is (one layer, spread 9 px at silence to 30 px; the WEB-1305 tests read its fourth length, so don't add an inset shadow or a second layer) and `transition: box-shadow 90ms linear`. Update the comment above the rule to: `/* While listening: the microphone as a picture above Done, not a control: an outline
   ring and microphone on the panel, as the app draws it, its halo following the voice
   from 9 px at silence to 30 px at a loud voice. */`. This is the organizer's choice between the reviewer's two options (a mint fill, or a transparent fill with a 2 px green ring): the ring, because it is how the app draws it and because a mint fill would merge with the mint halo into one larger disc. What not to touch: `VoiceDemo.tsx` (the span, its `aria-hidden`, its ref and the level loop stay; no new focus stop, no `tabindex`), `recorder.ts`, `.voice-record-button` and `.voice-record-button.is-recording` (Done stays the filled worded button), the reduced-motion block (`.voice-level { transition: none; }`, near `:646`), any string, and every other rule in `voice.css`, which holds this run's other b1 work. No new colours or tokens. No existing test should break: the WEB-1305 tests (`tests/ux-web-voice.spec.ts`, ‘WP63 level circle’) check visibility, aria-hidden, the svg, focus, position and the box-shadow spread, none of which changes. Checks: `npm run check`; `SITE_URL=https://taskflow.garbar.tech npm run build`; `npx playwright test tests/ux-web-voice.spec.ts --reporter=dot -g "WP63|WEB-1305|WEB-1304|WEB-1302"`; renders `UX_RENDERS=1 npx playwright test tests/ux-renders.spec.ts --workers=6 --grep-invert "perf " -g "voice-recording|voice-capture"`.
acceptance: On /, /es/ and /ca/ at 1440 × 1000 and 390 × 664, light and dark, while listening with Chromium's fake microphone: `span.voice-level`'s computed `background-color` is `rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)`, and differs from the computed `background-color` of `#voice-record` in the capture stage before tapping it (light rgb(23, 110, 89), dark rgb(158, 213, 179)).

In the same states: `span.voice-level`'s computed `border-top-width` is `2px`, its `border-top-style` `solid`, and its `border-top-color` and `color` both equal the computed `var(--green)` (light rgb(23, 110, 89), dark rgb(158, 213, 179)); its box is still 80 × 80 px and its `border-top-left-radius` makes it a circle.

The WEB-1305 tests still pass unchanged on both projects, light and dark: the circle is aria-hidden, unfocusable, holds one svg, sits centred above Done, and its box-shadow spread stays between 9 and 30.5 px and moves from 9 within 3 s; under reduced motion it takes at most three spreads (9, 19.5, 30) and no transition. axe reports no violations while listening.

Renders `voice-recording.en.{desktop,mobile}.{light,dark}.{view,panel}.png` and `voice-recording-50s.en.*`: the circle above Done is an outlined green ring with a green line microphone on the panel's background inside the mint halo; side by side with `voice-capture.en.*.panel.png`, it no longer matches the filled green record button with a white microphone.
Done (`#voice-record` while listening) is unchanged: the filled green worded button, focused after tapping the microphone from the keyboard (the WEB-1304 test still passes).
deviceChecks: A first-time tester on a real phone (Chrome on Android, Safari on iPhone), on /es/: tap the microphone, speak, and stop. They stop with «Listo» on the first try, without tapping the circle.
Windows high-contrast (forced colours): the ring and the microphone stay visible while listening.
